# Leborn

**AI-native rebirth of popular legacy OSS.**

Leborn is an initiative to revive widely-used open-source projects whose original maintainers have moved on, with **AI-native enhancements designed for the 2026 era of software**.

## What we maintain

| Project | Original | Status |
|---------|----------|--------|
| [LePico](https://github.com/leborn-dev/lepico) | [Pico CMS](https://github.com/picocms/Pico) (PHP) | Phase 1 pilot |
| [LeFuel](https://github.com/leborn-dev/lefuel) | [FuelPHP](https://github.com/fuel/fuel) | Phase 2 |
| [LeVue](https://github.com/leborn-dev/levue) | [Vue 2.x](https://github.com/vuejs/vue) | Phase 3 (AI migration tool focus) |
| [LeNg](https://github.com/leborn-dev/leng) | [AngularJS 1.x](https://github.com/angular/angular.js) | Phase 3 (AI migration tool focus) |
| [LePoly](https://github.com/leborn-dev/lepoly) | [Polymer](https://github.com/Polymer/polymer) | Phase 3 (AI migration tool to Lit) |
| [LeRefinery](https://github.com/leborn-dev/lerefinery) | [Refinery CMS](https://github.com/refinery/refinerycms) (Ruby) | Phase 1-2 |
| [LeTG](https://github.com/leborn-dev/letg) | [TurboGears](https://github.com/TurboGears/tg2) (Python) | Phase 2 |

## Beyond maintenance: AI-native rebirth

We don't just patch the past. Each Leborn project gets reimagined for how people actually work in 2026:

- **CMS projects** (LePico, LeRefinery): Chat-based content updates via LINE / WhatsApp / Slack / Telegram. Voice-to-Markdown. AI multilingual auto-translation.
- **Framework projects** (LeVue, LeNg, LePoly, LeFuel, LeTG): AI-assisted migration tools that help your codebase move forward, not just stand still.

## Sponsorship and transparency

Leborn is sponsored and operated by [**LLL Sdn Bhd**](https://lll.dev), an ASEAN-based software company. We are transparent about this — Leborn is not a foundation. It is a sponsored open initiative committed to keeping critical OSS alive.

The name "Leborn" comes from "Reborn" with the R replaced by L (for LLL).

## Licensing

Each project retains its original license (MIT/BSD/Apache/etc.). All forks honor the original copyright and contribution attributions in commit history.

## Contributing

Each project repository has its own CONTRIBUTING.md. We welcome:
- Bug reports and patches
- Migration tool improvements
- Documentation improvements
- AI-native feature contributions

For project-level discussions, see individual repository Issues.
